comments.body: Mind if I ask how you managed to get the room on Turnerstrasse? ETH has shared a short list of flats for international master students (I will start in september) on their website but it is not clear to me how they are allocated. As far as I know, vacant rooms advertised directly on Woko's website are pretty much impossible to get , beceause they typically receive 100+ applications and tennants for most other Woko rooms are chosen directly by the other roommates.
comments.author: Tall_Ladder8399
